title_it: Dave, Espresso Corner Chicago (americano): Marea 2 a 110 V, non scalda, fuori garanzia
title_en: Dave, Espresso Corner Chicago (American): Marea 2 110 V, no heat, out of warranty

lines.text: Hi, good morning. This is Dave from Espresso Corner, in Chicago.
lines.cue: Good morning, Sereni service, Michael speaking. How can I help you?

lines.text: We have the Marea 2, the two group. The serial number is zero four one, three zero two.
lines.cue: Hello Dave. Which machine do you have, and do you have the serial number?
lines.expect_it: Macchina: Marea 2. Scheda macchina 041302: Espresso Corner, 110 V, FUORI GARANZIA (scaduta agosto 2026).

lines.text: Since this morning the machine stays cold. The pressure gauge is at zero, no steam, no hot water.
lines.cue: Thank you, I have your machine on file. What is it doing?

lines.text: Yes, everything is on, the lights, the buttons. No alarm. But it is cold.
lines.cue: Are the lights and the touchpad on? Has the boiler filled, no level alarm?
lines.expect_it: Tu scegli «Accesa, caldaia piena, fredda» → passo pulsante di ripristino.

lines.text: Okay, I found the red button, I pressed it. Ten minutes later it is still cold. Nothing.
lines.cue: Switch the machine off. Behind the rear panel there is a small red button on the boiler: press it, switch on and wait ten minutes.

lines.text: Yes, I hear the click when I switch on. But no heat.
lines.cue: When you switch on, do you hear the contactor click behind the panel?
lines.expect_it: Tu scegli «Scatta ma non scalda» → passo tensione.

lines.text: It is one hundred ten volts, the American version. We bought it in 2024.
lines.cue: What voltage is on the rating plate: 230, 110 or 400?
lines.expect_it: Tu scegli «Marea 2, 110 V» → «Cosa fare ora»: CA-1181 + CA-1220 con prezzi e consegna, montaggio con il service, FUORI GARANZIA (paga il cliente), slot della seconda chiamata dopo l'arrivo dei pezzi: prenotane uno e leggi la frase.

lines.text: Understood. Please send it. Can you also add a box of the cleaning tablets?
lines.cue: The heating element has failed. Your warranty ended in August, so the part and the service call are charged. I ship the 110 volt element from Florence; fitting needs our service on the line.
lines.expect_it: Scheda pastiglie CR-6052 dalla descrizione, lo monta il cliente.

lines.cue: Done: element, gasket and tablets. We call you when it arrives to book the fitting. Goodbye.
lines.expect_it: «Chiudi chiamata» → resoconto: tecnico/service a pagamento, fuori garanzia.
